verdict.rationale: Sift documents a public REST API with an Events, Decisions, Score, Workflows and Webhooks reference portal. It adds multi-language examples, dated versioning with a changelog, and a sandbox environment with separate API keys, so programmatic users can drive it end to end. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of API-driven use (the one user report calls the documentation 'slightly confusing'), and no live try-it runner.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Sift easily integrates into your existing systems using modern REST APIs, Javascript snippet, and SDKs for iOS and Android.
You will also send this data from your application to Sift via our Decisions API.

developers.sift.com is a full API reference portal (Events, Decisions, Score, Workflows, Webhooks APIs) with per-language implementations selectable per page (curl, Python, Java, and more) and request/response examples
Use your Sandbox REST API key for accessing Sandbox users when testing. Switch to your Production API key for your live integration
